messages:
Nina (Sales): Heads-up — customer 'Zebra AI' asked for a hosted sandbox demo next Tue 16:30-18:00 UTC. They need a scoped sandbox key, IP allowlist, and a temporary increase to sustain ~200 requests/min with short bursts ~350 req/min. Model: redwood-xlarge-v1, avg response ~600 tokens. No sensitive data planned.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Streaming chat? Which endpoint are they using? Need token estimate for billing and a route whitelist.

Nina (Sales): Chat with streaming enabled. Endpoint: /v1/chat/completions only. Upper bound calc: 350 req/min * 600 tokens * 90 mins = ~18.9M tokens worst-case; expected ~5M tokens. They'll pay for usage after demo.

Talia (Infra): For hosted quota bump we need org ID + exact IPs/CIDR + signed confirmation of no PII + whether key should auto-expire. Also want to know if they need embeddings/rerank disabled.

Nina (Sales): Org: org-zebra-88. IPs: 3.12.45.0/24 and 54.38.12.99. Key expiry: 19:00 UTC (30m cushion). Disable embeddings/rerank. I'll email the signed confirmation now.

Maya (Finance): Quick note: since there's no PO, any overage will be invoice-post-demo. Approve soft quota increase but require alerting if projected usage > $2000.

Talia (Infra): @ops-rate please create a scoped key with per-route allowlist, per-minute token soft-quota set to 220 req/min equivalent, burst cap to 400 req/min for 5m sliding window, and time-based expiry. Route traffic to us-east pool. Set log-sampling 10% for eval.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-4999: "Sandbox demo rate window - Zebra AI (org-zebra-88)"  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4999

ops-bot: Scoped key provisional: sk-sbox-zebra-****ef12  expires 2026-08-18T19:00:00Z  per-route allowlist /v1/chat/completions only  soft-quota 220 req/min  burst cap 400 req/min (5m window)  log-sample 10%.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Can we also apply a client-side guidance snippet? I'll paste a quick snippet to recommend exponential backoff + 429 handler for the customer.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Code snippet:
```
if (resp.status === 429) {
  await sleep(backoffMs);
  retry();
}
```

Talia (Infra): Fallback policy: if us-east pool capacity < threshold, route to redwood-medium-v1 (same region). Streaming falls back to non-streamed response. Ops will monitor RW-4999 and escalate if error rate > 2% for 3 consecutive minutes.

Nina (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll confirm with Zebra and share the scoped key once they sign the data-handling note.

ops-bot: RW-4999 -> status: scheduled -> monitoring enabled

Nina (Sales): Follow-up: customer signed the note and verified IPs. Scoped key tested. Demo scheduled. :rocket:
